tools.name: search_photos
tools.description: Search the catalogue (English or French, synonyms and typos tolerated). Returns watermarked previews, metadata and fixed prices. Never returns originals.

tools.name: get_photo
tools.description: One photograph with its metadata, fixed price and machine-readable licence terms.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Fixed price (tax included, EUR) and licence terms for one photograph. The quote is signed and valid 15 minutes. Prices are not negotiable.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Creates an order from a valid quote and returns a payment URL (hosted payment page, tax handled) and the secret order_token. Nothing is charged by this call: the buyer pays on the returned URL. Calling again with the same idempotency_key and quote returns the same order. Both accept_terms and immedi

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: State of an order: pending (waiting for payment), paid, expired or failed. Poll every few seconds after the buyer pays.

tools.name: get_license
tools.description: Licence of a paid order as JSON, or as a PDF certificate (format=pdf).

tools.name: get_download_link
tools.description: Signed link (valid 5 minutes) to download the full-resolution original of a paid order. At most 10 links per order.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_order" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
